title: Repair the trunk's GitHub acceptance: two test expectations and the generated tool matrix
requested_outcome: Repair the trunk: GitHub acceptance on clive/trunk has failed since 7914ed8d because three landed changes each left one check behind. Make exactly these three edits and nothing else. (1) tests/test_pwa.py, test_recovery_needs_no_hand: the line asserting 'pollHealth(true);', 'acquireWakeLock();' and 'warmMic();' in the body of wentOnline() pins the behaviour the microphone fix deliberately removed. Replace it with an assertion that 'pollHealth(true);' and 'acquireWakeLock();' are in the body, a comment saying the microphone is opened only by a hold to speak and never by coming back online, and an assertion that 'warmMic();' is not in the body. (2) tests/test_voice_credits.py: the fixture line SECRET = "sk_elevenlabs_test_key_0123456789abcdef" is flagged by the repository secret scan as a new key. Keep the same value but build it in two parts, SECRET = "sk_elevenlabs_" + "test_key_0123456789abcdef", with a comment saying it is built in two parts so the repository secret scan does not read the test fixture as a key. (3) docs/phase4/TOOL_MATRIX.md is out of date because tests/test_scenes.py now names tools: in the tests column of exactly these fourteen rows, insert test_scenes.py in alphabetical position among the listed test files: commerce_aggregate, commerce_query, email_query, gmail_find_in_email, gmail_read_thread, gmail_search, shopify_find_customer, shopify_find_order, shopify_inventory, shopify_list_orders, shopify_order_address, shopify_order_detail, shopify_order_note_append, shopify_sales_summary. tests/test_tool_matrix.py compares the file with the generator's output byte for byte. A tree with these three edits passed full repository acceptance in the Director's environment (3852 passed, secret scan clean). The earlier attempt at this objective failed its listed check twice; its check included the secret-scan provenance test, which needs tools the sandbox does not have, so that test is left to GitHub acceptance and the listed check now covers the three edits only. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: exactly the three stated edits and nothing else
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
